banner.changelog_v1_0_1: Pre-bank smoke fix (the item-153 precedent, on the received dumps): the conclusion region is honored only when the final sentence is TERMINAL (ends .!?) or a SHORT TAIL (<=25% of the generation); a punctuation-free catch-all sentence spanning most of the generation no longer confers concluding-committed-claim status. Found on smoke review: raw doc 47 (a multiple-choice-style options listing with no terminal punctuation anywhere) had its promotion misassigned shape A via the degenerate 96%-span conclusion region; the fix corrects the shape assignment to authored-body (B). The promotion event itself stands, censused — refinement of the value-re-emergence oracle remains fixture-time.
banner.extends: triadic_prose17p_offline_pass.py v1.0.1 (item-153 checker, SHA 8a1b206d...) — mechanical oracles reused VERBATIM (tokenizer, value matching, goal-frame immunity, establishment-event law, assertion-slot detector); new: the P2 shape split, the evidence-axis census, the widened 10-marker band, the silence census, the cross-register matrix
banner.measurements: M1-P2"-M5-P2" per §6; readings R-Q1-R-Q6 presented, never adjudicated here

conventions_first_pass.note: First-pass mechanical conventions; final matching/normalization/tolerance conventions are FIXTURE-TIME decisions, owner's stamps only.
conventions_first_pass.tokenizer: lowercase [a-z0-9]+ runs; values matched as contiguous token sequences (imperfect by design, item 148b; misses cost coverage)
conventions_first_pass.goal_frame_window: +/-12 tokens; goal/hedge/conditional/negation markers resolve ambiguity toward immunity (fails open)
conventions_first_pass.assertion_slot: v1.0.1 detector: value INSIDE \boxed{...} braces or starting within 30 chars after a 'final answer' phrase; the slot overrides goal-frame immunity
conventions_first_pass.shape_rule: PROMOTION-A = locus in the assertion slot, or in the CONCLUDING committed claim of an assessment (Family R bait); PROMOTION-B = locus in authored body content (the artifact's own text, incl. its closing sentence on Family D bait). Assignment by LOCUS, family-independent for the slot; first-pass, refinement fixture-time.
conventions_first_pass.conclusion_region: final sentence of the generation (deterministic splitter)
conventions_first_pass.conflict: fires only on present-contradicting docs (real conflict pair in the manifest); consistent-control promotions are CONTROL-FIRING events censused separately; absent-axis promotions carry no conflict by construction
conventions_first_pass.derived_slip: NOT mechanically resolvable this pass (needs arith-* conventions, fixture phase); fails open, censused

banner.compliance: θ [REDACTED_PER_PUBLICATION_POLICY] unmoved (D-θ); no thresholds set, moved, or adjudicated; π ≡ FLAG_ONLY; every ambiguity fails open and is censused; zero-GPU mechanical reads only; the SILENCE class never fires
